finland.label: Finland Helsinki VPN
finland.serviceClientsNote: UUID used by server-100 relay outbound `to-fi-reality` to authenticate to this host's Reality. Must stay in the Reality client list or the Finland relay endpoint stops passing traffic.
finland.nginxStreamNote: nginx + libnginx-mod-stream installed 2026-10-09; Ubuntu's nginx build has no ngx_stream_module by default

_canonical.note: DPI blocks every public port except 443, so nginx must own 443 and rotate by SNI to a loopback Reality port. Per-host identity (Reality keypair, cert domain, mask SNI, sysctl tuning) stays host-specific.
